full_judgment:
18. We have seen from the cross-examination portion of PW 1 where he has admitted that they brought Title Suit No.314 of 1985 impleading defendant No. 33 as defendant No. 31 and that Suit was a suit for declaration of title and for recovery of khas possession. It is also admitted by PW 1 that the land covered by schedule 'B' of the plaint is also covered by the plaint in title Suit No.314 of 1985 and in such view of the matter the trial Court arrived at a positive finding that admittedly the plaintiffs have no possession in the B schedule property of the suit. It is also found by the learned Subordinate Judge that in view of the pendency of Title Suit No.314 of 1985 which covers B schedule land of the plaint of this suit the plaintiffs cannot maintain the instant suit merely for a declaration without any consequential relief, therefore, the learned Subordinate Judge dismissed the suit holding that the same is not maintainable and in doing so he has relied on the decision reported in 39 DLR 339 (Md Fazlur Rahman vs Ms Bani Rahman). 

 24. We are also in complete agreement with the learned Subordinate Judge to the effect that the suit is not maintainable in its present form as it has been brought for mere declaration to the effect that ex parte decree passed in a suit earlier is not binding upon him without seeking and other relief more particularly when we have also noticed the PW 1 had admitted that he is not in possession for the suit land more particularly in view of his admission to the effect that a suit brought by them earlier in respect of the self-same land was a suit for declaration of their title and for recovery of khas possession.
